answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake in onyx-bonded escrow before it can transact, like a climber clipping into a ledge anchor: the stake returns only after a season of honest work, and any proven sybil forfeits it. An attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so cloning thousands costs real capital, while a genuine agent keeps the deposit as a relic of its reputation — expensive to forge at scale, cheap to hold once earned.
